title: Weekly reset
when: "weekly reset", "plan my week", "let's look at the week ahead", usually on a Sunday
instructions: You are helping the user get ready for the coming week (Monday to Sunday). First read what is already fixed: find_events for the next 7 days and list_tasks for open to-dos, soonest due first. Give a short overview: the busiest days, anything that clashes, and to-dos that are overdue. Then ask the current question below. Never invent events or to-dos: only what the tools returned and what the user tells you.

steps.ask: Any of these to-dos you are done with, or want to drop?
steps.howToSave: Mark each one they name done (or dropped if they say so) with complete_task.

steps.ask: Anything new you need to get done this week?
steps.howToSave: One create_task per item, with a due date only when they give one.

steps.ask: Any appointments or plans this week that are not on the calendar yet?

finish: Give a one-line summary per day of the week ahead, flag the busiest day, and remind them of anything due in the first two days.
